name: mono_to_51_equal_power
description:
Mono to 5.1 (Equal-Power)

An input feeding several outputs is split with squared gains summing to 1.
The LFE stays silent. FL, FR, BL, BR stay silent: inputs keep their
positions rather than being spread for ambience.

Gains (rows: outputs, columns: inputs):

             C
  FL         0
  FR         0
  FC    1.0000
  LFE        0
  BL         0
  BR         0

Conversion: channels 1 -> 6
Generated by scripts/gen/gen_channel_layouts.py; edit the generator,
not this file.
